evidenceSource: pred.gg coreBuild (RANKED only, patch 1.15 (pred.gg version ids 152+153); ordered 3-item cores, 20+ games each); hero-wide + per-role for flex heroes
method: 100 stratified crit sequences; high-health diagnostic target; three-item cores with actual costs. First two scenarios fix attack opportunities to isolate mechanics. Third uses each build attack rate with zero cast recovery: an optimistic contact ceiling, not a feasible measured combo. No Purge or Dash. Ablations retain item stats and stat conversions; only replay event behavior is disabled. Deltas interact and must not be added together. Removing Vengeance also removes Dusk eligibility.
limitations: Controlled action replay, not a fight policy or win-probability model. Hit times/raw payloads/crit outcomes are explicit scenario inputs.
Vengeance and shred stacks refresh together; damage uses pre-hit stacks, then applies new stacks. Trigger ordering needs gameplay confirmation.
Secondary item/passive packets do not recursively trigger stack effects. Purge tick count and per-tick triggers are not inferred.
Solaris uses the triggering hit critical outcome. Ashbringer is allowed once per ability cooldown cycle, following the catalog wording.
Ruination drains uniformly over four seconds; refresh extends the existing drain rate. Tick cadence and refresh behavior require gameplay confirmation.
Power ratios use the current engine bonus-power basis. Healing is potential output, not effective healing or shield value.
Knell, augments, Dash power/reset stacks, actor mana budgets, projectile travel, attack animations, misses, incoming damage and target healing are excluded.
All Tainted Rounds on-hit damage, anti-heal value, Terminus overheal shields and Manta farming stacks remain omitted.
